full_text: When you are healed by a health globe, gain {life_regen_pct} Life regeneration per second and {movement_speed_pct} increased movement speed for {duration_seconds} seconds. This bonus stacks up to {max_stacks_count} times. | Unlocked at level 10. | "When the sky bleeds, the crops grow tall. When our enemies bleed, we grow strong." —Chant of the Harvest

You deal {damage_bonus_pct} additional damage to enemies below {life_threshold_pct} health. | Unlocked at level 10. | The clans each paint their warriors in their own unique way. Some celebrate the mountain, others honor the fire, but the Targos clan worships the purifying virtue of pain.

Fatal damage instead reduces you to {life_floor_pct} Life. For {duration_seconds} seconds afterward, you take {damage_taken_pct} reduced damage and are immune to all control-impairing effects. | This effect may occur once every {internal_cooldown_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 13. | "The trials begin with childhood; skinning ferocious beasts, climbing windswept cliffs and carrying weapons heavy enough to make a southern soldier weep. Is it any wonder that they never give ground?" —Sir Aric of Duncraig

Gain a bonus based on the weapon type of your main hand weapon: | Swords/Daggers: {damage_bonus_pct} increased damage | Maces/Axes: {crit_chance_pct} Critical Hit Chance | Polearms/Spears: {attack_speed_pct} attack speed | Mighty Weapons: {gain_resource} Fury per hit | Unlocked at level 16. | "My men ambushed the traveler in the woods, but it was we who were surprised. Such keen senses, swift motions, flawless strikes. We never stood a chance." —Redjack the Bandit

The duration of your shouts is doubled. After using a shout you and all allies within {radius_yards} yards regenerate {life_regen_pct} of maximum Life per second for {duration_seconds} seconds. | Your shouts are: | Battle Rage | Threatening Shout | War Cry | Unlocked at level 20. | "The enemy poured through the gap until Warmaster Karja impaled three demons at once on our battle standard, tossing their corpses into the fray below as she roared a rallying call from high atop the battlements." —The Battle of the Starless Night
You deal {damage_bonus_pct} additional damage while near maximum Fury. | Unlocked at level 20. | "You wouldn't like me when I'm angry." —Bannar the Berserker

Each point of Fury spent heals you for {heal_life} Life. | Heal amount is increased by {heal_pct} of your Health Globe Healing Bonus. | Unlocked at level 24. | "Compassion is weakness. To press the advantage when an opponent calls for mercy is the way of true power." —Halaberd the Conqueror

Increase all Fury generation by {regen_pct}. | Increase maximum Fury by {max_pool_resource}. | Fury is used to fuel your most powerful attacks. | Unlocked at level 27. | "While most orders teach the merits of calming the seas of the soul, the guardians of Arreat have embraced the raging inner storm." —Chronicler Arlavoc

Reduce all non-Physical damage by {damage_bonus_pct}. When you take damage from a ranged or elemental attack, you have a chance to gain {gain_resource} Fury. | Unlocked at level 30. | "The sorcery of the west has brought us nothing but blight. Strength built these walls, and strength will hold them." —Gruchac Hammerhand
Increase Armor by {armor_pct}. | Increase Thorns by {thorns_pct}. | Unlocked at level 30. | After a while the scars serve as their own layer of armor.

Increase the damage of Weapon Throw, Seismic Slam, Ancient Spear, and Avalanche by {damage_bonus_pct} against enemies more than {radius_yards} yards away from you. | Unlocked at level 35. | "Run if you must, but you'll only die tired." —Ooron Goons

While below {life_threshold_pct} Life, all skills cost {cost_reduction_pct} less Fury, Life per Fury Spent is doubled, and all damage taken is reduced by {damage_taken_pct}. | Unlocked at level 40. | No matter the odds, some warriors simply refuse to fall.

As long as there are {nearby_enemy_count} enemies within {radius_yards} yards, all of your damage is increased by {damage_bonus_pct}. | Unlocked at level 45. | "I have two blades, one for each of you." —Blademaster Kharne

The duration of control-impairing effects on you are reduced by {cc_duration_reduction_pct}. In addition, whenever a Stun, Freeze, Fear, or Immobilize is cast on you, you have a chance to recover {heal_pct} of your maximum Life. | Unlocked at level 50. | "I swear to you, we put a dozen arrows into him and he just stood back up. These so-called barbarians, these madmen of the north—there is no stopping them." —Soldier of Bastion's Keep

You no longer degenerate Fury. Instead, you generate {gain_resource} Fury every {interval_seconds} second. | Unlocked at level 55. | "It was as if he suddenly came to know every grievous injury endured by his ancestors, and he had selected that very moment to exact their collective revenge." —Chronicler Arlavoc

Reduce the cooldowns of your: | Earthquake by {cooldown_reduction_seconds:earthquake} seconds. | Call of the Ancients by {cooldown_reduction_seconds:call_of_the_ancients} seconds. | Wrath of the Berserker by {cooldown_reduction_seconds:wrath_of_the_berserker} seconds. | Unlocked at level 60. | The aid of the Immortal King shall come to those who have earned it.

Gain {gain_resource} Fury when Avalanche or Earthquake is triggered. | Unlocked at level 64. | "My capital has become the cell in which I await my execution. The ground roars beneath me, announcing the presence of the wild men, as they rend and tear the foundations of the world and laugh. Oh, woe is me that I ever confused their savage ways for weakness."—Loren, Panep of Samauren

While wielding a shield, reduce all damage taken by {damage_reduction_pct} and reduce Fury costs by {cost_reduction_pct}. | Unlocked at level 66. | "Turning away the attack of an enemy saps their resolve as surely as landing a blow of your own." —Battlemaster Kal-Jor

Increase Strength by {primary_stat_pct} for {duration_seconds} seconds after killing or assisting in killing an enemy. This effect stacks up to {max_stacks_count} times. | Unlocked at level 68. | "The battle was never ending, sapping our minds and bodies to the point of exhaustion. But they thrived amidst the carnage, every killing blow renewing their bloodlust. They couldn't be stopped." —Sergeant Peshkov on the Siege of the Barbarians, 1123 Anno Kehjistani
